description: Estimate annual and monthly home insurance ranges for a California property and return the normalized inputs, available risk-factor ids, and ZIP-level context notes that explain the estimate.

home_sqft.description: Approximate finished living area of the home in square feet.

risk_factors.description: Optional Coverage Cat risk-factor ids, such as `pool` or `old_systems`, for property traits that can change premium.

zip.description: ZIP code for the California property being estimated.

name: home_calculator

available_risk_factors.description: Every risk factor you can pass in risk_factors, whether or not it was applied.

impact_pct.description: Percent the factor adds to the premium.

disclaimer.description: Notice that these figures are informational estimates, not binding quotes; relay it with the numbers.

estimate.description: Premium range for the home, in US dollars.

annual_high.description: High end of the annual premium range.

annual_low.description: Low end of the annual premium range.

monthly_high.description: High end of the monthly premium range.

monthly_low.description: Low end of the monthly premium range.

risk_factor_count.description: How many recognized risk factors were applied.

zip_risk.description: ZIP-level premium tier before risk factors: `Standard`, `Moderate`, `Elevated`, or `High`.

inputs.description: The ZIP, square footage, and risk-factor ids the estimate used.

risk_factors.description: Risk-factor ids as sent, including any the estimator did not recognize.

zip_facts.description: Context notes that explain the ZIP's premium tier.

title: Home insurance calculator
